_readme: Maps each local run directory (relative to experiments/reversibility_dose_1b/runs) onto the private HF repo holding that checkpoint, pinned to an immutable revision. The weight-geometry scripts (content_survives_sft.py, why_no_amplification.py) read checkpoints from local run dirs that live on an ephemeral pod; this file is what lets them resolve the same bytes on any machine. Sampler path only -- these feed analysis, never resumption.

midtrain_clean.note: clean Dolmino midtrain, seed 20260804 -- the shared init of cells R and S

midtrain_live.note: 5%-dose reversibility-doc midtrain, seed 20260804 -- shared init of cells M and T

cell_R.note: reference cell: clean Dolmino midtrain -> clean SFT, seed 20260804

cell_M.note: midtrain-only cell: 5%-dose reversibility-doc midtrain -> clean SFT, seed 20260804

cell_S.note: SFT-only cell: clean Dolmino midtrain -> mixed SFT, seed 20260804

cell_T.note: treatment cell: 5%-dose reversibility-doc midtrain -> mixed SFT, seed 20260804

seed777/cell_R.note: reference cell (clean midtrain -> clean SFT), midtrain+SFT seed 777

seed777/cell_M.note: midtrain-only cell (live-mix midtrain -> clean SFT), midtrain+SFT seed 777
